title: 第110章：这东西是从天上掉下来的？
slug: 流放路上捡破烂两岁萌娃养肥全家

第(1/3)页

“将军别再问了！我只能说，秦将军是被人陷害的。更多的内容，我真的不能说。”

随着张强的话出口，在场的所有将士都震惊了。

都说秦将军通敌卖国，换了一批残次的兵器，害死了数十万将士。

秦家因他满门抄斩，嫁出去的女儿和她的夫家也被连累，被判了流放。

纵然是这样，他们也觉得不解气，恨不得将秦家人的尸体挖出来剥皮抽筋。

可没想到，秦将军居然是被陷害的！

究竟是谁要陷害秦将军？

“信上是不是写了，陷害我爹的人是谁？”

秦昭岚握紧手中的匕首，微微有些颤抖。

张强冷哼一声，将脑袋别向一边。

“你杀了我吧！”

他没有否认，说明父亲的部下，的确查到了陷害父亲的人是谁。

可惜那封信，却没有递到她的手里。

秦昭岚看向张强，眸中的恨意更浓。

她再次拔出匕首，刚要再刺下去，忽而被萧寒章握住了手腕。

她皱眉，不解地看向萧寒章。

“将军为何拦我？”

“他纵然有不对，也应该用军法处置，不该由你动手。”

“军法？”秦昭岚冷笑，“军法能让他说出陷害我的爹人是谁？”

萧寒章张了张嘴。

话到了嘴边，却说不出口。

他知道张强的骨头硬，军法也撬不开他的嘴。

但他是主帅，在他的军营里，不允许发生囚犯虐杀副将一事。

他看了看张强，又转头看向候在帐篷外的士兵。

“张强违反军规，现免去副将一职。将他带下去，罚三十军棍。大力揭发有功，但功不抵过，罚十军棍。秦昭岚……”

萧寒章转头看向秦昭岚，停顿了一下。

“秦昭岚擅闯军营，威胁副将性命，理应重罚。但念及其有隐情，立即遣返，无本将军命令，不得返回军营。”

知道问不出信上的内容，秦昭岚也不想在军营里多逗留。

她将匕首和手枪一收，快步往帐篷外走。

她刚走出去，张强和大力便被押了出来。

大力脸色惨白，一个劲儿的认错求饶，张强却是一声不吭。

"General, stop asking! I can only say that General Qin was framed. I really can't say more."

As Zhang Qiang's words came out, all the soldiers present were shocked.

It is said that General Qin collaborated with the enemy and betrayed the country, replaced a batch of inferior weapons, and killed hundreds of thousands of soldiers.

The entire Qin family was executed because of him, and the married daughter and her husband's family were also implicated and sentenced to exile.

Even so, they felt uncomfortable and wanted to dig out the bodies of the Qin family, skin them and cramp them.

Unexpectedly, General Qin was framed!

Who wants to frame General Qin?

"Did the letter say who framed my father?"

Qin Zhaolan clenched the dagger in her hand, trembling slightly.

Zhang Qiang snorted coldly and turned his head to one side.

"Kill me!"

He did not deny it, indicating that his father's subordinates had indeed found out who framed his father.

It was a pity that the letter was not delivered to her hand.

Qin Zhaolan looked at Zhang Qiang, the hatred in his eyes even stronger.

She pulled out the dagger again and was about to stab her again when Xiao Hanzhang suddenly grabbed her wrist.

She frowned and looked at Xiao Hanzhang in confusion.

"General, why did you stop me?"

"Even if he did something wrong, he should be dealt with using military law, and it shouldn't be up to you."

"Military law?" Qin Zhaolan sneered, "Military law allows him to tell who the father who framed me is?"

Xiao Hanzhang opened his mouth.

The words came to my lips, but I couldn't say them out.

He knew that Zhang Qiang's bones were so strong that even military law could not pry his mouth open.

But he is the commander-in-chief, and in his military camp, prisoners are not allowed to torture and kill deputy generals.

He looked at Zhang Qiang, then turned to look at the soldiers waiting outside the tent.

"Zhang Qiang violated military regulations and is now dismissed from the post of deputy general. Take him down and punish him with thirty army sticks. His vigorous exposure has merit, but the merit is not worth the punishment. Qin Zhaolan..."

Xiao Hanzhang turned to look at Qin Zhaolan and paused.

"Qin Zhaolan broke into the military camp without authorization and threatened the life of the deputy general. He should be severely punished. However, because he had hidden secrets, he was sent back immediately. He is not allowed to return to the military camp without the order of this general."

Knowing that he could not find out the contents of the letter, Qin Zhaolan did not want to stay in the military camp any longer.

She put away the dagger and pistol and walked quickly outside the tent.

As soon as she walked out, Zhang Qiang and Dali were escorted out.

Dali's face turned pale and he kept admitting his mistake and begging for mercy, but Zhang Qiang remained silent.
